note: Common beat ledger. Every unit forks from this file. Times are pass-relative seconds (one pass = 35.0 s, 24 fps, 960x540). Picture events are AUTHORED by U1's animation and must land on frame round(t*24) +/-1. Change only through a new revision of this file. Moving a voice onset across SIL-H, or an edit across an address boundary, invalidates the other tracks' reviews.

film_layout.content: HANDMADE card: numeral 'I', Instrument Serif, #efefef on #1e1e1e (reference anchors); no word about timing

shots.name: WAKE
shots.framing: close-up: head resting on hand against pillow and patterned wall; head height >= 0.35 of frame; book and negative rebate cropped out
shots.camera_viewpoint: beside the bed at his head height, outside him, looking at his face (he looks down, not into lens)

shots.name: TELEPHONE
shots.framing: close: the crank wall telephone box fills >= 0.45 of frame height, coats as a dark near plane at right
shots.move: slow push 1.00 -> 1.04, coats drift 2x the wall

shots.name: REFUSE
shots.framing: head and shoulders against the pale wall, his flash-cast shadow on the wall beside him (the double), the black door jamb at frame right
shots.camera_viewpoint: across the room at seated head height, outside him; his eyes are turned off-lens
shots.move: lateral glide settling to rest by 10.5

shots.name: HELD
shots.plate: LoC 2017862340 (same rig as S3, closer: head height >= 0.42 of frame)
shots.framing: the reference's scale: pale wall left, head on the boundary, shadow and jamb dark on the right

shots.name: FLIGHT-1
shots.plate: LoC 2017811447 (Vachon, Dec 1940; figure cut out, wall extended)
shots.framing: medium: stair and banister; climbing figure head-to-waist, head height >= 0.18 of frame
shots.camera_viewpoint: side-on to the stair from the hall below

shots.name: STAIRWELL
shots.framing: looking up the empty well, deep blacks, lit ceiling
shots.camera_viewpoint: foot of the stairwell looking up, empty

shots.name: FLIGHT-2 + TAIL
shots.plate: S5 frames 0..131 reused byte-identically (27.0-32.5), then S5's last frame held (32.5-35.0)

events.name: wake: head piece lifts off the hand and rights itself
ring 3 heard, not answered (head turns at 9.25 toward the sound, shadow follows, holds; returns at 10.4; no reach)
flight 2: figure enters frame (same frames as E4)

clauses.text: You hear it through the wall.
You take the same stairs again, one step after another.

offset_rule: A.on = event.t_on - 1.2; B.on = event.t_on + 1.2 (tolerance 0.05 s). Durations identical across tracks.
allowed_edit_crossings: c2.A starts in S1 (4.8) and runs into S2, the shot holding its own event E2: allowed.
c3.A starts in S2 (7.8) and runs into S3, the shot holding its own event E3: allowed.

guards.note: c3.B ends 11.4 (0.1 s before SIL-H); c4.A starts 19.3 (0.3 s after SIL-H).

defining_beat.condition: c5.B visible on >= 0.8 s of frames after E6.exit (31.5) with zero figure-alpha coverage; planned 1.0 s

baseline.condition: c4.B [21.7, 23.0] lies wholly inside the figure-visible interval [20.5, 23.5]

caption_setting.band: neutral #1e1e1e at 60% opacity drawn by the editor (NOT kit caption's cream PAGE band)
